lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the gill slits, with spot diameter and inter-spot distance increasing toward the posterior region of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of circular blobs, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient transition from high luminance on the dorsal aspect to shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: High concentration of commensal teleosts, specifically Echeneidae, clustered around the pectoral fin and the ventral-lateral margin of the shark.
